UploadMediaInput.description: Represents the input needed for creating a pre-signed upload URL.

alt.description: The alternative text for the media item.

database.description: The database of the media item.

includeExtensionInItemName.description: The indicator to include the file extension with the item name.

itemPath.description: The relative path, under sitecore media library, of the media item.

language.description: The language of the media item.

overwriteExisting.description: The indicator to overwrite the media item.

versioned.description: The indicator to version the media item.

presignedUploadUrl.description: The absolute URI for the api to upload the media file.
